description: Publish a post now. Publishes to every target at once, the portal's Publish Now. Needs a caption (stories excepted), media for any Instagram target, and two or more items for a carousel (400). A draft, scheduled or failed post can be published (409 not_editable otherwise). When a platform rejects it the post becomes failed and the call is 422 publish_failed with the post and per-platform results. post.published or post.failed fires either way. Send {} as the body.
name: publish_post
